transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our pre-load coordination huddle started. We have three loads ready for movement to the support site during the 0700-1300 window: a clinic cold-chain pallet, a generator replacement pallet, and a routine administrative-supplies pallet. We have Trucks T-1, T-2, and T-3 available. Before I approve any vehicle assignments and loading sequence, I need transportation, maintenance control, and medical logistics to report any current handling or receiving requirements. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, during this morning's vehicle check I confirmed that only Truck T-2 has a functioning refrigerated-power inverter approved for the clinic cold-chain pallet. That equipment note hasn't been added to the movement worksheet yet, but the cold-chain pallet needs to go on T-2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a maintenance issue before we assign anything. During the current axle inspection, I confirmed that Truck T-3 is limited to 2,500 kilograms. The generator replacement pallet weighs 3,200 kilograms, so T-3 cannot carry that load. I should note that this revised limitation is still awaiting entry in the vehicle status board, so it won't show up there yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report the receiving clinic's fixed appointment times. I confirmed with the receiving clinic that the cold-chain pallet has a 0900 appointment, the generator pallet has a 1030 appointment, and the administrative-supplies pallet has a 1200 appointment. This appointment sheet has not yet been cross-referenced with the movement plan, so we need to make sure our vehicle assignments and loading sequence align with these times.
transcript.speaker: A4
